module merging_features

using Statistics

function _merge_feat(arrays)
    N = 0
    for a in arrays
        N += size(a, 2)
    end
    merged = similar(arrays[1], size(arrays[1], 1), N, size(arrays[1], 3))
    idx = 1
    for a in arrays
        n = size(a, 2)
        merged[:, idx:idx+n-1, :] .= a
        idx += n
    end
    return merged
end

function merge_feat(feat_dicts::Vector{Dict})
    keys_set = keys(feat_dicts[1])
    for d in feat_dicts[2:end]
        keys_set = intersect(keys_set, keys(d))
    end
    merged = Dict()
    for key in keys_set
        merged[key] = _merge_feat([d[key] for d in feat_dicts])
    end
    return merged
end

function approximate_diagonal_angle(vectors)
    norms = sqrt.(sum(vectors.^2, dims=2))
    normed = vectors ./ norms
    cos_angle = clamp.(normed[:, 1], -1.0, 1.0)
    angle = acos.(cos_angle)
    return angle
end

function merge_feat_col(feat_dicts::Vector{Dict}, key)
    return _merge_feat([d[key] for d in feat_dicts])
end

end

module feat_batch

using Base.Iterators: partition

struct FeatBatch
    data
    shape
end

function FeatBatch(data::AbstractMatrix)
    return FeatBatch(data, size(data))
end

function _partition_batch(batch::FeatBatch, batch_size::Int)
    parts = partition(1:batch.shape[2], batch_size)
    return [FeatBatch(batch.data[:, idxs]) for idxs in parts]
end

function to_device(batch::FeatBatch, device)
    # Julia does not require explicit device transfer like PyTorch
    return batch
end

function detach(batch::FeatBatch)
    return batch
end

end


module msa_pairing

using LinearAlgebra
using SparseArrays

function _make_pair_mask(inds1::Vector{Int}, inds2::Vector{Int})
    mask = zeros(Bool, length(inds1), length(inds2))
    for (i, idx1) in enumerate(inds1)
        for (j, idx2) in enumerate(inds2)
            if idx1 == idx2
                mask[i, j] = true
            end
        end
    end
    return mask
end

function msa_pairing(msa_inds1::Vector{Int}, msa_inds2::Vector{Int})
    mask = _make_pair_mask(msa_inds1, msa_inds2)
    return mask
end

end
